# book_calendar_plan (Resource)

The calendar_plan records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references

### Optional

- `ai_request` (Dynamic) The model request the plan was generated from, written with the plan.
- `bookable_ids` (List of String)
- `entries` (Dynamic) The planned entries; a bookable is named by bookable_key and a part by bookable_object_key and bookable_keys.
- `owner_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `user_ids` (List of String)
- `wish` (String)
